jobs.prompt:
Edit this exact SHARK MODEL REFERENCE sheet to refine ONLY HIS HAIR in ALL six character depictions: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, BACK, both expression close-ups and the small READY pose. The user says his hair is too wild and voluminous, but MUST remain LONG. Preserve the character identity and all other body/costume/weapon details. Change the revision title to 'MODEL REFERENCE 04'.

HAIR DIRECTION: keep his white/silver color and existing long length, reaching down the upper-to-mid back when settled. Reduce the mass, outward spread and lifted crown substantially, roughly one-half of the current fan-like silhouette width. It should lie close to the skull, sweep backward from the forehead, follow the nape and fall as a slimmer controlled shape along his back. Use a few clean grouped locks with restrained pointed ends, not dozens of thick radiating spikes. Smooth the enormous outward flying triangular mane into a low-profile, naturally swept-back head and long narrow trailing locks. In the side view, show a shallow hair cap over the skull with long hair following the neck/back; in the back view, a slimmer curtain of long hair rather than a wide starburst. The tips should still reach at least below the shoulder blades in full-body neutral views. Keep a few familiar face-framing strands, without covering his teal eye mask. No wind-machine effect on neutral poses. Do not shorten the haircut, turn it into a bob, shave sides, add a ponytail tie/braids or new accessories. Long, loose, controlled, lower volume.

KEEP UNCHANGED: small mature angular face; teal eye mask; eight-head athletic anatomy; broad swimmer shoulders and powerful arms; teal scale vest; bone jaw on anatomical LEFT shoulder; rope belt/net; slate trousers; split teal sash; wrapped brown boots; RIGHT hand long hooked gaff with a continuous connected open silver hook, LEFT hand separate short triangular blade. Same front, right-side and rear poses, expression gestures, grounded ready stance, and exact equipment/palette panels. Same neutral upper-left lighting, 2–3 flat cel tones, confident dark contour, slate #34454D, bone #D9D4BD, teal #258A99. Preserve title/labels except revision number; identical landscape layout and warm neutral opaque background. No changes to muscles, equipment, weapons, clothing, height or stance. Make the hair reduction very clear while retaining long-haired Shark's recognizability.
